entries.title: Psalms 47:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> All ye peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God with the voice of triumph!

entries.title: Psalms 47:2
segments: For Jehovah, the Most High, is terrible, a great king over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 47:3
segments: He subdueth the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:4
segments: He hath chosen our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 47:5
segments: ¶God is gone up amid shouting, Jehovah amid the sound of the trumpet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:6
segments: Sing psalms of God, sing psalms; sing psalms unto our King, sing psalms!

entries.title: Psalms 47:7
segments: For God is the King of all the earth; sing psalms with understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 47:8
segments: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 47:9
segments: The willing-hearted of the peoples have gathered together, [with] the people of the God of Abraham. For unto God [belong] the shields of the earth: he is greatly exalted.
